title: 28-Layer Parametric Quadratic Chirp with Bounded Optimization
scientific_hypothesis: A parametric quadratic chirp model (t_i = t_base + k·i + c·i²) with derivative clipping can achieve target scores ≥0.85 while maintaining physical chirp consistency and reducing optimization degrees of freedom from 28 to 3 parameters.
design_principle: Quadratic chirp provides monotonic thickness progression matching physical deposition constraints while enabling broadband UV reflection through progressive optical path variation across the stack depth.
proposed_topology: exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers)
manufacturing_considerations: Parametric model reduces deposition control complexity compared to independent optimization
Quadratic profile compatible with standard deposition monitoring systems
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
Chirped distributed Bragg reflector theory for broadband reflection
expected_advantages: Reduced optimization dimensionality from 28 to 3 parameters
Physical chirp consistency enforced by model structure
known_risks: Parametric constraint may limit achievable performance compared to independent optimization
Quadratic model may not capture optimal non-monotonic thickness distribution
execution_request_english: Optimize a 28-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate under normal incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-... (28 layers total, starting with HfO2 at air interface). Use parametric quadratic chirp model: thickness_i = t_base + k*i + c*i² where i is layer index (0-27). Optimize parameters t_base, k, c with bounds t_base∈[30,150] nm, k∈[-5,5] nm/layer, c∈[-0.5,0.5] nm/layer². Apply derivative clipping to ensure thickness_i ∈ [20,250] nm for all layers. Evaluate spectral performance across 300-1700 nm with dual-band objectives: maximize mean reflectance 300-450 nm, maximize mean transmittance 1000-1700 nm. Use gradient-based optimizer with 1000 iterations maximum. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum total layer count of 30.
revision_reason: Addresses feedback directive to enforce physical chirp consistency by switching from per-layer independent optimization to bounded parametric chirp model with quadratic profile
